notes.title: Cyber-Doge 2077 Announcement
notes.content:
Hello friends!
We have a new game coming out soon - Cyber-Doge 2077: Meme runner.
[previewyoutube=wyzZi_0rXMk;full][/previewyoutube]
About the game
Furious 3D runner about a pumped up dog. Run as far as possible! Collect coins! Set new records and enjoy a great soundtrack.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1383720/Cyberdoge_2077_Meme_runner/

If you like the game, please add it to your Steam Wishlist.

Best regards,
Take Toad.

notes.title: New hero added
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35855193/03c96a3ec39d6eae307bb0388bb5a3cdf21200cf.png

Story
The daughter of the head of the clan White paw. The life of the palace princess was not to her liking. Katerina loved good armor more than palace robes. She left the house and embarked on the thorny path of the killer, joining the ninja cats. And now, when her father with his orders is far behind, she will take part in the Steel Paw test.
